plugins.name: anamnesis
plugins.description: Persistent, encrypted memory for Claude Code. Deterministic capture via SessionStart/UserPromptSubmit/Stop/SessionEnd hooks. Per-user HKDF-derived keys — vendor cannot decrypt your memory. 0.3.2 makes capture non-blocking and incremental: Stop runs in a detached background worker and ships only the transcript lines added since the last turn, and large uploads no longer silently die on ARG_MAX. OAuth 2.1 + PKCE end-to-end via 'anamnesis-config'; hooks send Authorization: Bearer with automatic refresh rotation (legacy X-Anamnesis-Key sunset 2026-05-20). Visible, searchable, deletable memory surface at anamnesis.smtry.ai.
